records.short_description: Callebaut 811 is a Belgian dark couverture chocolate sold in India in callet (disc) form, produced by Callebaut and commonly used by professional and home bakers for melting, molding and glazing.

Morde Dark Compound is a cocoa-solids-and-sugar-based compound chocolate slab manufactured by Morde, an Indian bakery-ingredients company, positioned as a lower-cost alternative to couverture chocolate.
Van Houten Cocoa Powder, a Dutch-processed cocoa brand now owned by Barry Callebaut, is sold in India in medium-brown grade for baking and beverage use.
Amul's Dark Compound Chocolate Bar (DCO-18) is a cooking/baking compound chocolate produced by Amul and sold in a 500g bar format for melting and coating.
Morde Dark Compound Chocolate Chips are small-format compound chocolate pieces made by Morde for baking, garnishing and folding into batters.
Weikfield Cocoa Powder is an unsweetened cocoa powder made by Weikfield Foods Pvt. Ltd., widely distributed across Indian grocery and quick-commerce platforms.
Hershey's Cocoa Powder is a natural, unsweetened cocoa powder sold in India through Hershey's own India storefront and major online grocery retailers.
BB Royal Maida is a refined all-purpose wheat flour sold under BigBasket's BB Royal private label.
Weikfield Double Action Baking Powder is a sodium-bicarbonate-based leavening agent manufactured by Weikfield Foods Pvt. Ltd. and sold in a reusable poly jar.
Weikfield Corn Flour is a corn-starch product, one of Weikfield's original two products since the company's 1956 founding in Pune, used for thickening and baking.
Urban Platter Baking Soda is a triple-refined, food-grade sodium bicarbonate sold by Urban Platter through its own site and major Indian marketplaces.
Eagle Icing Sugar is a finely ground powdered sugar sold under the Eagle brand of Indian branded foods through BigBasket and other grocery retailers.
Weikfield Vanilla Custard Powder is an egg-free, vanilla-flavoured custard mix manufactured by Weikfield Foods Pvt. Ltd. for fillings, trifles and desserts.
CCDS Baking Powder is sold as a house/store-branded product through CCDS's own online shop, one of India's larger cake-decorating and baking-supply store chains.
Magic Colours Spectral Gel Colours are concentrated, highly pigmented gel food colours manufactured in India under license by Motek Sugarcrafts.
The Spectral Genie Gel is a tube-format version of Magic Colours' gel food colour line, an alternative dispensing format to the brand's bottled gels.
Colourmist Soft Gel Paste is a concentrated, highly pigmented food-colour line manufactured by Bakersville India Pvt. Ltd. and sold across major Indian marketplaces.
Puramate Liquid Food Colour is part of Puramate's essence-and-colours product line, sold through the brand's own site and Indian quick-commerce platforms.
Puramate Culinary Essence Assorted is a 10-flavour set of liquid flavour essences sold by Puramate, an Indian FMCG brand founded in 2019.
Urban Platter Premium Vanilla Extract is an alcohol-free vanilla extract marketed as made with real Indian vanilla, sold via the brand's own site and Indian marketplaces.
Wilton Gel Food Coloring is a concentrated gel-based icing colour line from the US bakeware and decorating brand Wilton.
Vizyon Sugar Paste is a ready-to-use fondant/sugar paste line supplied by Bakersville India Pvt. Ltd. for covering cakes and modelling decorations.
Tropolite Premium Whip Topping Cream is a non-dairy whipping cream produced by Tropilite Foods for cake and pastry icing/decoration.
Rich's Chocolate Whip Topping is a chocolate-flavoured non-dairy whipped topping sold through Rich's India's own online store.
Rich's Truffle Base is a ready-to-use chocolate ganache-style base product for fillings, glazes and truffle-style desserts.
FunCakes Rolled Fondant is a European ready-to-roll fondant brand distributed to cake-decorating retailers internationally, including sellers that ship to India.
Nutella Hazelnut Spread with Cocoa is Ferrero's globally distributed hazelnut-cocoa spread, sold in India through major online grocery platforms.
Amul Fresh Cream is a 25%-milk-fat dairy cream sold in tetra packs by Amul, commonly used for whipping and cake fillings.
Wilton Edible Baking Sprinkles is a cake and cupcake decoration sprinkle mix from Wilton, listed for sale to Indian customers.
Wilton Rainbow Nonpareils are small round sprinkles sold by Wilton for topping cupcakes, cookies and cakes.
Wow Confetti is Bakersville's edible confetti/deco sprinkle range, sold through the brand's own storefronts for cake, cupcake and dessert decoration.
Glint Pearl Spray is an edible spray product from Bakersville's Glint range, marketed for giving cakes and desserts a pearlescent finish.
JVG Chocolate Sprinkles are chocolate-flavoured decoration sprinkles manufactured by JVG Traders Private Limited for cake and ice-cream decoration.
JVG Rainbow Sprinkles are multi-coloured decoration sprinkles manufactured by JVG Traders Private Limited for cake and ice-cream decoration.
PME Edible Sugar Pearls are small sugar-ball decorations, part of PME's Sugarcraft range, made in Germany for PME and sold internationally.
Wilton 16-Inch Disposable Decorating Bags are single-use piping bags sold by Wilton and listed for direct purchase on Amazon.in.
Wilton's Aluminum Bakeware Round Tiered Cake Pan Set is a four-piece anodized-aluminum pan set designed for even heat distribution.
Borosil's Round Baking & Serving Dish is a borosilicate-glass bakeware item marketed by Borosil as oven-, microwave- and dishwasher-safe.
Wonderchef's Cake Moulds line is a non-stick bakeware range sold directly through Wonderchef's own India ecommerce site.
The PME Supatube is a seamless stainless-steel decorating tip made in England for PME, used for fine writing and string work on cakes.
The Ateco 783 is a 55-piece piping tip set containing writing, star, leaf, rose, grass, basketweave and flower tips in a hinged storage box.
The Lukzer listing photographs a bundled cake decorating kit including a 360-degree turntable and a tool set, sold directly on Amazon.in.

records.short_description: PME Cake Drum Board is a rigid, silver-finish round drum board from PME's Sugarcraft range, replacing an R1-proposed listing whose brand could not be confirmed.

provenance.replacement_note: Replaces the R1-proposed "Round Silver Cake Boards (18-Inch, Pack of 6)" listing, whose manufacturer/brand attribution could not be confirmed from available sources. PME's brand identity is already independently verified elsewhere in this catalog (PME Supatube, PME Edible Sugar Pearls).

records.short_description: This silver round cake board is sold directly by Cake Craft Shop, an Indian cake-decorating tools and supplies retailer, as a base for presenting finished cakes.
This tall corrugated cake box with a display window is sold by The Baker's Mart, an Erode-based Indian bakery-supplies retailer, for packaging taller cakes.
This brown cake box with a display window is sold directly by Eco Bags India for packaging bakery items up to about 1kg, with customization available.
Famous Packaging, a Mumbai-based packaging wholesaler, lists a curved-window bakery box under its Window Bakery Boxes product line.
Pirsq is a supplier platform for paper cake and bakery boxes across India, offering cake boxes with window and logo-printing options for bakeries and cafes.
